meta.title: The Next Chapter
meta.subtitle: Senior living communities and services around Richmond

listings.name: Williamsburg Landing
listings.blurb: An accredited Life Plan Community blending colonial architecture with resort-style amenities and year-round cultural, educational and social programming, minutes from the College of William & Mary.

listings.name: Brandermill Woods
listings.blurb: A Life Plan Community in Midlothian for 40 years, with beautifully appointed cottages and apartments built around freedom, independence and a close-knit social life.

listings.name: Cedarfield
listings.blurb: A Life Plan Community on a wooded 95-acre campus since 1996, with first-rate amenities, dining and wellness built around independence, individuality and a secure plan for the future.
